title: Trick Quiver
description: An archery combat mod: switch between 12 magic arrows, craft bow attachments, battle clockwork archers, and raid a Japanese-style boss shrine. One arrow solves everything.
body:
# Trick Quiver

  > **One arrow solves everything.**

  Trick Quiver is an archery-focused combat mod. Swap between a whole quiver of magic arrows on the fly, upgrade your bow with attachments, craft at dedicated workbenches, and take
  on Japanese-inspired structures and bosses — all built around the bow.

  ## ✨ Features

  ### 🏹 12 Magic Arrows
  Switch arrow types and reshape every fight:
  - **Teleport** – blink to where your arrow lands
  - **Explosive** – detonate on impact
  - **Lightning** – call down a bolt
  - **Mining** – break blocks at range
  - **Vampiric** – heal from the damage you deal
  - **Chain** – arc between nearby enemies
  - **Lure** – pull mobs toward the impact
  - **Smoke** – drop a concealing cloud
  - **Scatter** – fire a spread of pellets
  - **Light** – illuminate dark areas
  - **Ricochet** – bounce between targets
  - **Red Core** – a high-tier arrow with a delicate, crafted design

  ### 🔧 Bow Attachments
  Install up to 6 attachments to customize your bow: Glove, Grip, Scope, Lethal Arrowhead, Rapid-fire Trigger, and Lightweight Holder. Attachments are shown right on the bow model.

  ### 🛠️ Dedicated Workbenches
  - **Bowyer's Workbench** – attach and manage bow parts with a click
  - **Archer's Crafting Bench** – craft arrows, blocks, and gear

  ### 🤖 Clockwork Archers
  Automaton archers with 6 abilities across two factions — hostile raiders (red core) and friendly guardians (blue core) you can summon to follow or hold position.

  ### ⛩️ Structures & Bosses
  Explore the **Archer's Village**, discover the **Shrine of the Red Oni** boss dungeon, and raid the **Clockwork Vault** with its mechanical warden boss (two phases). Naturally
  generated structures plus a full illustrated in-game **Archery Guidebook** to teach you everything.

  ## 📦 Compatibility
  - **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
  - **Loader:** Fabric
  - **Requires:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
